metrics.name: NC_BIKE_TIME_HOURS_DIVISOR_60

metrics.description: Sums all event ID values across race results. This is a non-standard calculation (indicated by NC prefix) that adds numeric event identifiers rather than counting events. Use with caution as summing ID values typically doesn't provide meaningful business insights. May be used for technical validation or debugging purposes rather than standard business analysis.
metrics.name: NC_EVENT_ID_TOTAL

metrics.description: Sums the overall relative performance scores across all race results. This non-standard calculation (indicated by NC prefix) aggregates relative performance metrics. Use when analyzing cumulative relative performance across multiple results, though individual relative performance metrics are typically more meaningful for analysis.
metrics.name: NC_OVERALL_RELATIVE_TOTAL

metrics.description: Calculates bike seconds by multiplying across split data relationships. This non-standard calculation (indicated by NC prefix) appears to aggregate bike times through the split table structure. Use when analyzing bike performance data that needs to account for split-level granularity, though standard bike time metrics are typically more appropriate for most analyses.
metrics.name: NC_SPLIT_MULTIPLIED_BIKE_SECONDS

metrics.description: Converts total run segment time from seconds to hours by dividing by 3600. Use when questions ask about 'run time in hours', 'hours spent running', or when hour-based time analysis is preferred over seconds. Helps provide more readable time measurements for longer run segments and facilitates easier comparison of run performance across different time scales.
metrics.name: RUN_TIME_HOURS

metrics.description: Calculates the total run segment time in seconds across all results. Use when questions ask about 'run time', 'running duration', 'time spent running', or 'run segment performance'. Helps analyze running performance trends, compare run times across athletes or events, and measure run segment efficiency in triathlon competitions.
metrics.name: RUN_TIME_SECONDS

metrics.description: Converts total swim segment time from seconds to hours by dividing by 3600. Use when questions ask about 'swim time in hours', 'hours spent swimming', or when hour-based time analysis is preferred over seconds. Helps provide more readable time measurements for swim segments and facilitates easier comparison of swim performance across different time scales.
metrics.name: SWIM_TIME_HOURS

metrics.description: Calculates the total swim segment time in seconds across all results. Use when questions ask about 'swim time', 'swimming duration', 'time spent swimming', or 'swim segment performance'. Helps analyze swimming performance trends, compare swim times across athletes or events, and measure swim segment efficiency in triathlon competitions.
metrics.name: SWIM_TIME_SECONDS

metrics.description: Calculates the complete race time by summing swim, bike, run, and both transition times in seconds. Use when questions ask about 'total race time', 'overall finish time', 'complete duration', or 'end-to-end time'. Helps analyze overall race performance, compare complete race times across athletes or events, and measure total triathlon completion efficiency.
metrics.name: TOTAL_RECORDED_SECONDS

metrics.description: Calculates the combined time spent in both T1 (swim-to-bike) and T2 (bike-to-run) transitions in seconds. Use when questions ask about 'transition time', 'T1 and T2 time', 'time between segments', or 'changeover duration'. Helps analyze transition efficiency, identify areas for performance improvement, and compare transition performance across athletes or events.
metrics.name: TOTAL_TRANSITION_SECONDS

metrics.description: Counts the distinct number of race results that have detailed split time data available. Use when questions ask about 'how many results have splits', 'split data availability', or 'detailed timing coverage'. Helps assess data completeness for split-level analysis and understand which results can be used for detailed segment performance analysis.
metrics.name: RESULTS_WITH_SPLITS

metrics.description: Calculates the percentage of race results that have split timing data available by dividing results with splits by total results. Use when questions ask about 'split data coverage', 'percentage with detailed timing', or 'timing data completeness rate'. Helps evaluate the quality and completeness of detailed timing data for analysis and reporting purposes.
metrics.expression: IFF(((COUNT(*) = 0) OR (COUNT(*) IS NULL)), NULL, (COUNT(DISTINCT FCT_SPLIT.RESULT_ID) / COUNT(*)))
metrics.name: SPLIT_COVERAGE_RATE

metrics.description: Calculates the total time in seconds across all race segment splits (swim, bike, run, transitions). Use when questions ask about 'total split time', 'segment duration', 'leg performance', or 'split times'. Helps analyze performance across individual race segments, compare leg-specific times, and understand detailed race breakdowns beyond overall finish times.
metrics.name: SPLIT_TIME_SECONDS

metrics.expression: IFF(((IFF(((3600 = 0) OR (3600 IS NULL)), NULL, (SUM(FCT_RESULT.SUM_OF_BIKE_SECONDS) / 3600)) = 0) OR (IFF(((3600 = 0) OR (3600 IS NULL)), NULL, (SUM(FCT_RESULT.SUM_OF_BIKE_SECONDS) / 3600)) IS NULL)), NULL, (SUM(DIM_DISTANCE.NOMINAL_BIKE_KM) / IFF(((3600 = 0) OR (3600 IS NULL)), NULL, (SUM(FCT_RESULT.SUM_OF_BIKE_SECONDS) / 3600))))
metrics.name: WEIGHTED_BIKE_SPEED_KM_H
